chapters.label: Last minute
chapters.text: Wembley, 1953, the FA Cup final. Blackpool were two goals down; now it's three all, last minute. Stanley Matthews gets it on the right, beats his man, races to the line, cuts it back... Bill Perry scores!

chapters.label: The shoulder
chapters.text: Slow motion. Matthews drops his shoulder, Banks leans the wrong way, and one touch round the outside takes him to the byline.

chapters.label: The cut-back
chapters.text: From the byline he cuts it back, low, just behind Mortensen. Perry smashes it in!

chapters.label: Your turn
chapters.text: Your turn: take on the full-back, get to the byline, cut it back across goal.
